title: Fire-department access route at car dealership (Council Order 0015422)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The issue was whether a car dealership needed a fire-department vehicle access route under ABC 2006 Article 3.2.5.6.(1); the decision states the site building area was 604 m² and faced one street.
The record included an engineering field-density report, engineering correspondence, site photographs, a plumbing inspection report, a drainage-plan drawing and a plans-examination report.
The appellant reported ground frost and precipitation as reasons paving was incomplete before occupancy.

limitations: This is an older code-enforcement appeal, not a variance application.
